subject: Sev1: HelixPay throughput and 5xxs — bridge & executive communications
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helixpay.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: HelixPay On-Call <oncall@helixpay.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Latency spike + 5xxs on tokenization — observed since 08:06 PDT

Ava / Ben,

We started seeing a spike in 5xx responses from your tokenization endpoint at ~08:06 PDT this morning. Impact: our token ingestion pipeline is backlogged, downstream model calls are timing out at 10s. Key observations: 
- ~18% 5xx rate on /v1/tokenize across three availability zones
- Median latency jumped from ~45ms to ~1.2s
- No config changes from our side in the last 24 hours

Attached a small error snippet (error_snippet.txt) and our internal trace ids. Can your on-call join a bridge and confirm whether this is isolated to HelixPay or a larger surface? We can provide logs and request IDs on the bridge.

We are degrading to a queue and this is causing customer-facing timeouts for several high-value flows. Please confirm receipt and bridge link.

Thanks,
Samira
Head of Platform Reliability
HelixPay

[attachment: error_snippet.txt]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helixpay.com>, HelixPay On-Call <oncall@helixpay.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T08:35:45-07:00
Subject: Re: Latency spike + 5xxs on tokenization — initial triage notes

Ava / Ben / Samira —

Quick triage notes from the bridge:
- Observed memory pressure on the tokenization pod pool in us-west-2; OOM+evictions on two nodes around 08:05–08:09 PDT.
- Significant KV-cache miss rate increased (cache miss rate ~42%). That correlates to repeated cold-start model loads causing GPU queue lengthing.
- No config push seen in our deployment logs; a noisy traffic pattern (large-batch analytic job) looks correlated based on request footprint.

Immediate mitigations applied (completed between 08:28–08:33):
1) Scaled tokenization pod pool +20% (evens out request distribution).
2) Enabled short-lived fallback instance (model-quantized-2.1) to reduce GPU startup cost.
3) Triggered a rolling restart of two affected instances to free leaked memory.

Next steps (ETA & checks):
- Monitor 10–15m windows for reduction in 5xx rate.
- If 5xxs persist after 30m, we’ll temporarily throttle large analytic jobs at routing layer (will coordinate with HelixPay on blacklisting by client ID).

I’ve attached a snapshot from our runtime metrics (runtime_metrics_snapshot.png). I’ll post logs to the Jira ticket INF-7842.

—Rishi
Senior Staff, Runtime Engineering
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
[attachment: runtime_metrics_snapshot.png]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@helixpay.com>, Andrew Li <andrew.li@helixpay.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T12:03:12-07:00
Subject: HelixPay — executive status update (12:00 PDT)

Samira / Andrew —

Short exec summary: we detected and triaged a production issue impacting HelixPay tokenization starting ~08:06 PDT. Symptoms were an elevated 5xx rate (~18%) and increased request latency affecting customer flows. Redwood actions taken:
- Immediate bridge and triage completed; infra team (Rishi) applied mitigations (scale up, fallback instance, rolling restarts).
- Initial mitigations brought the 5xx rate down from ~18% to ~3% within 30 minutes; we are continuing to monitor.
- We’ve opened INF-7842 and will deliver a full RCA within 72 hours.

Near-term asks & commitments:
- Confirmation from HelixPay on impacted time window and any contractual implications you want us to consider.
- Redwood will provide a proposed compensation/credit calculation based on observed impact window and token counts — we’ll share this within 48 hours.
- Follow-up: full postmortem doc by EOD 2027-06-23.

Attaching our mutual action plan for transparency: helixpay_mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf. I’ll be available for a short exec call if you’d like more color.

Thanks for your patience — we know this is high impact and are prioritizing.

Best,
Ben Carter
VP, Customer Success
ben.carter@redwood.com
[attachment: helixpay_mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf]

- Immediate mitigations were successful in restoring steady-state by ~08:40 PDT.
- Action items we committed to:

Please confirm the impacted customer flows and any additional downstream areas you want us to include in the RCA. If everything looks good we’ll mark the incident as mitigated in the ticket and proceed with the postmortem timeline.
